name: Dropshipping
description: Your dropshipping teams: the Product Scout finds products on ads, supplier sites and trends; the Product Analyst checks profit, saturation, viral potential and supplier risk against your rules and sends the good ones to you; after you approve, the Ad Creator writes ad scripts, ad copy and posts and the Brand Designer names the store and designs the brand; the Store Analyst reads Shopify and Meta Ads and says what to scale or kill.
